name: Signal2Noise — Daily 80/20 Priority Filter & Side-Panel Focus Pill
summary: Applies the 80/20 Signal-to-Noise discipline right inside your browser side panel: capture up to 10 items for today, lock 2 to 4 as your non-negotiable Signal, and keep them anchored in view while you work.
metaDescription: Capture up to 10 daily tasks, lock your 2–4 true priorities into a calm side-panel pill, and ignore the noise. 100% local in your browser with zero cloud rent.
